venues.description: The venue kept, then the others, in the order sent; each with its reasons when it's among the likeliest.

names.description: Every name to choose from: theirs and their other names, once each. The rest become other names.

name.description: The name that will be kept.

onMap.description: Whether its parking is on the map.

places.description: Their different addresses and parking spots, once each: a choice when there's more than one.

addressFrom.description: The venue whose address and parking will be kept.

venue.description: The venue it's from, when there are several.

corners.description: How many times its corners were walked on the watch (TRK-13).

check.description: Whether to look at it first (shown as Check); the rest are likely fine.

why.description: Why it's suggested as it is, in a few words.

into.description: The pitch it's the same as.

name.description: Without into, kept, under this name.

choice.description: What happens to it: the user's choice, else the suggestion.

targets.description: The pitches it can be the same as: those the merged venue keeps, under the names they'll have.

problem.description: What's wrong with its choice; the merge waits until there's none.

pitches.description: Every pitch of the venues merged away, riskiest first, then more matches and corners walked first (DUP-8). The order depends only on the venues, so rows stay put while the choices change.

notes.description: Things to know, such as corners walked over the 20 a pitch keeps.

problems.description: Pitches that need a look before merging.

merge.description: What to send to POST /v1/venues/{id}/merge to merge exactly this; none while there are problems.

description: What merging these venues would make (DUP-7, DUP-8, DUP-11).
